root_cause: The Growth Swarm catalog contained twenty plays, but catalog presence was being conflated with execution completeness. Seven plays were still ARMED or READY_FOR_SURFACE and did not yet have a fully auditable trigger-to-executor-to-surface-to-outcome path.
decision: Require an execution contract for every play and complete the seven missing paths through existing canonical Powerhouse owners. Reuse the existing Persuasion Revenue Optimizer rather than introducing a parallel persuasion system.
prevention: Never call a Growth Swarm play built solely because it exists in the catalog.
A built play requires trigger owner, executor, surface, outcome metric, truth/privacy gate and execution_complete=true.
Persuasion must reuse powerhouse-persuasion-revenue-optimizer-v1 and may not create an independent sending budget.
Growth-play emails share the existing five-per-day email cap, suppression, opt-out and cooldown rules.
Benchmark contribution requires explicit optional consent and public aggregate output still requires minimum group size five.
Competitor/switch content must reuse the canonical SEO owner and pass owner/cannibalization and public-evidence gates.
